entries.label: Peace Walker — Mine Base / hangar
entries.prompt: Create ONE wide 16:9 empty static HD painted 2D fighting stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, based carefully on the attached original-game reference. Preserve each game's specific place, architecture, palette and materials. Continuous horizontal walkable fighting strip at the front. Remove every person, vehicle, HUD, scope reticle, annotation, logo and text. No collage, no spritesheet, no UI. Peace Walker underground MINE BASE hangar interior, original PSP. Preserve the photographed cavernous utilitarian room: tall pale grey green corrugated wall panels, black horizontal steel gallery walkways and thin yellow top rails, straight metal staircases, square grey tarpaulin-covered cargo blocks below, hard cool white overhead industrial light. Side view looking across the lower hangar floor, long elevated maintenance gallery crossing rear wall, dark steel posts, closed industrial bulkhead toward one side, several canvas-covered crates in back corners. Foreground uninterrupted broad grey slab/steel floor. No giant robot, no warehouse forklifts, no futuristic glowing circuits, no soldiers, no bright yellow prisoner jumpsuit, no interface.

notes: Location and episode checked against the listed screenshot references.
Static painted HD source; perspective, hidden surfaces and fine textures are adapted and not certified as exact 1:1.
No animation, collision layout, parallax separation or runtime admission.
References show the hangar approach/interior cargo galleries; central Peace Walker assembly bay needs a full visual reference before exact architectural validation.
